page.overview:
What is Minohtar?

Minohtar was a descendant of Anárion and sister-son of Ondoher, King of Gondor. In TA 1944 when the army of King Ondoher went out to fight the Wainriders, Minohtar was appointed Captain of the Right Wing of Gondor's armies in the battle. The Right Wing was to follow the king and his body guards to the Black Gate and onto the Dagorlad. However, the Wainriders sent their cavalry to launch a surprise attack on the main force, which the king was leading. The Wainrider assault overwhelmed the centre of the army, and King Ondoher fell. Minohtar then rallied his wing of the army to mount a desperate rear-guard defense, buying time for the un-engaged left wing of the army and the units at the rear of the ring wing to retreat. Minohtar and his men conducted a fighting retreat, but were ultimately overwhelmed at the entrance to Ithilien. Minohtar was one of the casualties of the battle, slain by an enemy arrow.

Had Minohtar lived, it is possible that he would have become king, but upon his death the throne was eventually granted to the victorious general Eärnil, whose son, Eärnur disappeared for good thus ending the line of Anárion.
